findings.F1: The tested result points the way the idea predicts but falls just short of the bar. The mean of forecast/10 × the excess 5-day return is +0.0045, with t 1.95 over 3,419 non-overlapping cases. The size, +0.51 % unusual move per case (strength 0.043), is 2.6 times the 0.19 % cost of a round trip.
findings.F2: The effect is mixed across coins and periods.
findings.F3: The relation is not linear across the forecast.
findings.F4: Where the coin's 20-day volatility stands within its own range shapes the effect. In the lowest tercile the measure is +0.0068 (t 1.97) and in the middle tercile +0.0095 (t 2.53). In the highest tercile it is -0.0034 (t -0.69), where the coin's own large moves drown it.
findings.F5: The plan's 5-day horizon is not where the measure is strongest.
